formula_reproduction.kind: pure pinned formulas, no population simulation
formula_reproduction.mechanism: The certified cap tests step_4_raw > other_aggregate_contributions. These quantities are mathematically equal for this input but differ by floating-point rounding. The certified zero-Class2 world enters case_1 and clips additional-rate Class4; restoring Class2 enters case_2.
formula_reproduction.national_causality: The national Class4 contributions are directly observed in the downloaded artifacts. Their entire attribution to this floating-point branch defect is not proved; the pure example demonstrates sensitivity, not a national decomposition of that cause.
formula_reproduction.not_proved: National floating-point causality is not proved.

logical_steps: Execute UC health modifiers, make annual dates explicit, and block inert constructions; update regression tests.
Construct LHA, childcare and Class 2 reversals, correct CPI baseline and document review diagnoses and gaps.
Adopt three affected Modal event replays, regenerate comparisons/summary and save review verification.
commits.reason: git add could not create the shared worktree index.lock (Operation not permitted). Main session must commit these files on replay/pilot.

findings.change: Apply the normalized parameter reform, clear parameter caches and rerun the pinned seeded UC modifier. Full national and synthetic nonzero checks establish execution.
Document raw-tree April processing versus managed dictionary January lookups; normalize dated windows explicitly, reject empty annual windows and start the AA reversal in January 2023.
Identical in-force worlds become inert_construction, withhold numerical assertions and block completion. Regression tests inject the B1 modifier defect and original AA date defect.
Anchor the 2026 allowance counterfactual to actual September 2025 CPI of 3.8%; name missing 2027-29 legislated uplifts as policyengine-uk#2239 and state the index correction's opposite direction.
SUMMARY and every event COMPARISON split construction_pending from model_or_data_gap; after three promotions the measure totals are 84 and 76.

Queue every measure's largest residual, with all eight review cause classes, source-level evidence and unsized national attribution. Name #2237 and #2238; retain post-pin HICBC fix, employee base, WFP vintage, CGT scope/behaviour and employer wage incidence. State opposite-direction AA, WFP and CPI diagnostics.

Correct the SB2024 Class 1 description, state identical AS2023/SB2024 10% to 8% worlds, and note the pinned FY 2023-24 Class 2 rate of £3.15 against the actual £3.45, later fixed in policyengine-uk#1887.
Reverse the April 2024 30th-percentile reset with LHA.freeze=true. Map HB plus UC to Welfare inside cap; retain outside-cap and behaviour limitations.
Restore the old £646.35/£1,108.04 caps and preserve later certified growth, with explicit annual 2023 versus June onset and omitted scope limitations.

Restore the documented compulsory April 2024 £3.70 rate at a £12,570 formula threshold, avoiding cash liability on the already-credited small-profits group. The retained >= boundary may overstate cost at exactly £12,570 (law required >). Later hypothetical uprating and voluntary/credit responses remain omitted.
State that reversing pooled residential gains to 10%/20% overstates the announced main-rate tax gain, in construction notes and comparisons; numerical results unchanged.

modal_execution.source_binding_note: All three full runs were validated and adopted against their exact frozen upload inputs. After adoption the Class 2 authoring function was updated to reproduce the already-uploaded £3.70/£12,570 registry; rebuilding the registry stayed byte-identical. The invalid reform-window type guard was also classified as TypeError for lint consistency, without changing valid execution. The focused UC-health repeat used the final source and produced the same numerical artifact bytes.

autumn_statement_2023.artifact_digest_validation: remote hash before engine import, plus existing managed-loader pre/post simulation checks

certified_bundle.engine_constraint_note: The bundle DECLARES policyengine-uk ==2.89.2. That is not this repo's preference; it is the data's own compatibility statement. Computing at a newer engine needs a NEW certified bundle, not a relaxed check — see #126.
certified_bundle.provenance: Read from the release's own release_manifest.json in policyengine/populace-uk-private on 2026-09-07, and independently confirmed by downloading the artifact at that revision and hashing it.
certified_bundle.registry_rule: The identity of the certified populace-uk artifact a UK compute run must execute against. Committed so verification is OFFLINE and byte-exact: a run checks the artifact it was handed against this digest before constructing a simulation, rather than trusting a filename or a path.
certified_bundle.why_this_bundle: It is the bundle the 14 existing UK results were computed against (run_id campaign-20260802-reckoner-t2, engine_version 2.89.2 in pe_results). A counterpart computed on a different bundle is not comparable to them.
